boxes.title: Police reform & encounters
items: Prakash Singh: State Security Commission; DGP from UPSC panel, **2-year** tenure

==No out-of-turn promotion or gallantry award== until cleared
Way forward: body-worn cameras, Kerala **Janamaithri Suraksha**, TN **Friends of Police**
